title: Recipe 24 — Docker and Helm (packaging a daemon shape for a cluster)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Twelve Dockerfiles, five single-binary targets, one Helm chart — and the chart branches on the spec's target, because a CLI run finishes and a daemon does not.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed starter and the recipe are never touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env into this one terminal.

groups.title: Beat 1 · the daemon shape the chart deploys

beats.label: Type the channel starter
beats.cue: “The recipe's values.yaml says target: channel — so this is the spec it is packaging. A Slack daemon with two gated tools.”

beats.label: Lint it
beats.cue: “Clean before we package it. Shipping a broken spec in a reproducible image just reproduces the break.”

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “This is the shape the Dockerfile picker and the chart templates both read: target channel means daemon, means Deployment, means an httpGet healthcheck.”

verify.note: prints the IR for target channel

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check asserts the emitted shape, installs the deps, and boots it: GREEN, gated at the spec's own env refs. That is what goes in the image.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the spec env refs gate

beats.label: Open the emitted daemon
beats.cue: “One TypeScript entry point. The Dockerfile's job is to copy this in and run it as uid 1100 with a read-only root filesystem — nothing more.”

beats.label: Blank the values file
beats.cue: “Everything the chart needs to know about this deployment lives in one file.”

beats.label: Type the recipe's values.yaml
beats.cue: “Target picks the templates, three replicas because a daemon scales horizontally, and every secret arrives by secretKeyRef — never as a literal.”

beats.label: Read the values back
beats.cue: “Nine top-level keys, and two env vars the chart promises to inject. Hold on to that list.”
beats.command: bun -e 'const v = Bun.YAML.parse(await Bun.file("live/my-values.yaml").text()); console.log("target:", v.target, "· replicas:", v.replicas, "· keys:", Object.keys(v).join(", ")); console.log("env the chart supplies:", v.env.map((e) => e.name).join(", "))'

verify.note: target: channel · replicas: 3 · 9 keys; env the chart supplies: ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, SLACK_BOT_TOKEN

beats.label: Ask the daemon what it actually boots on
beats.cue: “Exit 1, and three names — the chart's env block only supplies two. SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET is missing from values.yaml, and you find that here instead of in a crash-loop.”
beats.command: env -u SLACK_BOT_TOKEN -u SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN crewhaus channel verify live/crewhaus.yaml --offline

verify.note: deliberate non-zero — exit 1: 3 check(s), 3 failed (SLACK_BOT_TOKEN, SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN|ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). Scrubbed explicitly with env -u because the Setup group already sourced .env into this shell. --offline is the deterministic env-only pre-flight, no network.

beats.label: Blank the ServiceMonitor
beats.cue: “serviceMonitor.enabled true generates one more object. This is it.”

beats.label: Type the recipe's ServiceMonitor
beats.cue: “A Prometheus Operator resource pointing at the daemon's metrics port. The chart writes it; you never hand-maintain it.”

beats.label: Read it back
beats.cue: “Scrapes the metrics port every thirty seconds. Pair it with otel.enabled for the collector sidecar and recipe 17 has the four vendor exporters.”
beats.command: bun -e 'const m = Bun.YAML.parse(await Bun.file("live/servicemonitor.yaml").text()); console.log(m.apiVersion, m.kind, "→ port", m.spec.endpoints[0].port, "every", m.spec.endpoints[0].interval)'

groups.title: One more thing · build it and render it

beats.label: Build the channel image
beats.cue: [manual] “Wraps docker buildx with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH pinned to the spec's commit, so the same source gives the same digest — and records it in docker/digests.json.”

verify.note: needs a running Docker daemon and a network pull of oven/bun:1.2-alpine (the recipe's own prerequisite). Never executed by drivers:verify.

beats.label: Render the chart against those values
beats.cue: [manual] “helm template is the offline half of helm install — it shows you the Deployment, Service and Ingress the chart would create for a daemon shape.”

verify.note: needs helm on PATH plus a sibling factory checkout (../../../../factory from this driver dir). The demos CI clones factory but installs no helm, so this is never executed.

beats.label: The recipe's packaging smoke
beats.cue: [manual] “The recipe's own smoke walks all twelve Dockerfiles, the binary matrix, the four package manifests and a helm template — run it by hand; against factory main it currently stops on the binary-argv probe.”

verify.note: NOT driven offline: exits 1 against factory main on probe C — 'buildBinary emits bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64' — a stale argv expectation in the smoke, not a packaging break (probes A, B, D, E all pass). Needs a human until the expectation is refreshed.
